items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: He wanted to be like Benny Morkman and these other people up there.

ctx.x: But then he put the R in there, changed the spelling, huh? Yeah, he changed it— Somebody did. To Americanize the name.

Yeah. He just didn't want to be from the South. That's all. He wanted to be like Benny Morkman and these other people up there. He changed it himself. He changed it because it was so near like Mouton. He just put the R instead of using the U, see? Yeah. He just changed the one letter. That's right. One letter, that's all.
Well, I had never known that until I found out from here then.
